veranderings.blok: Vuil water kan 'n mens maagsiek maak
veranderings.voor: kom die kieme saam met die water in.
veranderings.na: sluk hy die kieme saam met die water in.
veranderings.rede: 'kom ... in' leaves it unclear where the germs come in; 'sluk ... in' is the natural verb for drinking and keeps the meaning.
'met 'n grootmens by' is a loose colloquial construction; 'saam met' is standard and keeps 'altyd' and the adult rule intact.

veranderings.voor: 'n Gas in die lug wat bome en plante opneem.
veranderings.na: 'n Gas in die lug wat deur bome en plante opgeneem word.
veranderings.rede: The relative 'wat' can grammatically be read as the gas taking up the trees; the passive makes clear the plants take up the gas.
